tooltip.guidedrailways.bogie: Aim at straight or curved Create track and use to place, or install beneath a physical body without rails\nSupply rotation at the top; wrench toggles brake; when off-rail, select the vehicle then use the wrench while aiming at track; sneak-wrench removes
tooltip.guidedrailways.coupler: Wrench two couplers to connect; wrench a linked coupler to disconnect; sneak-wrench removes\nUp to 2 blocks apart and 1 block height difference, without strict facing alignment
tooltip.guidedrailways.coupling_tool: Legacy tool remains usable; a wrench now connects couplers directly\nSneak-use to disconnect
